name: B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology
officialName: B.S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology (Deemed to be University)
summary: Crescent, near Tambaram at Vandalur, has run since 1984; the former Crescent Engineering College became a deemed university under Section 3 of the UGC Act on 16 December 2008. It is accredited A+ by NAAC and offers B.Tech, B.Arch, B.Des, pharmacy, law, commerce and science degrees. B.Tech admission combines Class XII merit with its own test, CIEAT, or a valid JEE (Main) score; tuition is charged in merit-linked slabs.

testing.notes: Or a valid JEE (Main) score for direct selection.

domesticTuition.notes: B.Tech tuition per year, by programme and by the student's Class XII Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry marks; plus a one-time ₹40,000 amenities and service fee.
